title: ScAI Visitor Talk
description: Exploring the real-world impact of AI beyond the hype.
body:
ARIES members will attend the talk by Prof. Veeravalli on fluid intelligence in modern AI systems.

ScAI and CSE seminars are one of the best ways to stay connected with cutting-edge research during the semester — come for the talk, stay for the discussion.

All events are synced with the ARIES Google Calendar so you never miss one.
